boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost places and campus activities for Truman students and the Kirksville community.

cards.title: Browse the University Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Ophelia Parrish Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Check the exhibition calendar, then enter through the west-side first-floor entrance and browse during listed gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: Rotating art exhibitions in Ophelia Parrish.
cards.evidence_claim: Truman states that University Art Gallery exhibitions are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 9 a.m.-5 p.m. and Saturday 11 a.m.-5 p.m.; closed between exhibitions and during University breaks.

cards.entity_name: Ruth Towne Museum and Visitors Center
cards.title: Explore the Ruth Towne Museum
cards.subtitle: Truman campus at Franklin and Normal streets
cards.notes: Stop in to view the interactive university-history displays, and confirm visitor-center availability before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A public museum focused on Truman and its history.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri's official tourism site lists Ruth Towne Museum as open to the public with free admission.
cards.access_notes: Located jointly with the University Office of Admissions; check the official museum or admissions information before visiting.

cards.entity_name: P. C. Mills Park Splash Pad
cards.title: Cool off at the P. C. Mills Splash Pad
cards.subtitle: P. C. Mills Park, Kirksville
cards.notes: Bring water and use the self-serve splash pad during regular park hours while the seasonal amenity is operating.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal public splash pad in a city park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Kirksville calls the P. C. Mills Park Splash Pad free, seasonal, and open to the public during regular park hours.
cards.source_title: Kirksville Aquatic Center | City of Kirksville
cards.access_notes: The city schedules the splash pad from May through September; it operates on a self-serve basis during regular park hours.

cards.title: Join a Drop-In Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Review the summer class schedule, wear comfortable workout clothes, and arrive ready for an instructor-led movement session.
cards.short_summary: Instructor-led fitness classes for the Truman community.
cards.evidence_claim: Truman Campus Recreation lists drop-in fitness classes among its free programs for students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Available to students, faculty, and staff; consult the current Campus Recreation schedule for class times.

cards.title: Try a TruStrength Orientation
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center Weight Room
cards.notes: Schedule an appointment at the Weight Room Desk, bring a friend if helpful, and learn the equipment and room etiquette.
cards.short_summary: A guided introduction to the recreation center weight room.
cards.evidence_claim: Truman lists weight-room orientations among its free Fitness-Wellness programs and services.
cards.access_notes: Orientations are by appointment for students, faculty, staff, and designated guests; sign up at the Weight Room Desk.

cards.title: Make an Intramural Team
cards.subtitle: Truman Campus Recreation
cards.notes: Browse the current Intramural calendar, join or create a team, and choose a sport or one-day tournament that fits your group.
cards.short_summary: Free team sports and tournaments through Campus Recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Truman says its Intramural and Competitive Sports program provides free competitive sports activities for students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: For Truman students, faculty, and staff; offerings vary each semester and no prior sports knowledge is required.

cards.entity_name: Pickler Memorial Library New York Times Membership
cards.title: Set Up the Library's New York Times Access
cards.subtitle: Pickler Memorial Library online service
cards.notes: Use a Truman email address to activate the membership, then save articles or share a reading pick with friends.
cards.short_summary: No-cost New York Times access for the Truman community.
cards.evidence_claim: Pickler Memorial Library states that New York Times membership is free for Truman students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Requires a Truman email address and is limited to Truman students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Use the Kirksville Bike Co-op
cards.subtitle: Campus community bike shop
cards.notes: Bring a bike project, ask the trained mechanics for guidance, and use the shop resources during the published Co-op hours.
cards.short_summary: A campus community bike shop with free use of resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Truman states that cyclists may use Kirksville Bike Co-op resources for free and receive mechanic advice and assistance free of charge.
cards.access_notes: The university lists weekday noon-to-4 p.m. hours and notes that components may have separate prices.

cards.title: Swim at the Truman Natatorium
cards.subtitle: Pershing Building
cards.notes: Check pool availability before heading over, bring standard swim gear, and use the facility during its announced open periods.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus pool available without charge to Truman affiliates.
cards.evidence_claim: Truman states that its pool is open year-round for students, faculty, and staff free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Free for students, faculty, and staff; the general public needs a valid pass. Confirm current pool availability before visiting.

cards.title: Settle into PML 107
cards.subtitle: Pickler Memorial Library
cards.notes: Meet classmates in the open lounge, then ask the front desk about checking out its conference room for a focused group session.
cards.short_summary: An open student lounge with a reservable conference room.
cards.evidence_claim: Pickler Memorial Library identifies PML 107 as an open student study lounge with a conference room available for checkout at the front desk.
cards.access_notes: Student study space; confirm conference-room checkout procedures and availability at the Library Service Desk.
